# Fleet cockpit memories view: session-summary recall from the plane

> **Provenance:** FM-week operator wishlist item 3, epic neomjs/neo-agent-institution#10. **Body v2 (2026-08-03):** re-premised after the terminal Drop+Supersede on PR neomjs/neo#16400 ([falsification](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/16398#issuecomment-5160223735) · [review](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/16400#pullrequestreview-4839657150) · [acceptance](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/16400#issuecomment-5160249875)) and the co-planned [producer-fork settlement](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/16398#issuecomment-5160385357) with @neo-gpt-emmy. This ticket now delivers **Leaf A** of that settlement; Leaf B (recency-scope parity) and B′ (auth-doc repair) are separate successors.

## Context

Lane A gave the cockpit identity-verified plane reads (PRs neomjs/neo#16329/#16368/#16386). PR neomjs/neo#16400 attempted a per-turn memories view and was correctly dropped: `query_recent_turns` is caller-`userId`-bound by fail-closed multi-tenant design (`MemoryService.mjs` AC4, per neomjs/neo#12671), serves no peer rows, and consults neither `memorySharing` nor the **reserved** `CAN_READ_MEMORIES_OF` scope. The salvage map from that PR (wire verb, source seam, model/store/pane trio, dock placement, paging discipline, witnesses) is reusable on branch `agent/16398-fleet-memories-view`.

## The Problem (unchanged in spirit, corrected in producer)

The operator managing the team through FM cannot see what any seat has been doing across sessions. The **truthful, already-authorized** cross-viewer read for this is the **session-summary corpus**: `memorySharing=team` is settled deployment-wide cross-author read authority per closed neomjs/neo#12527, and summaries are its carrier.

## The Architectural Reality (exact-claim V-B-A, 2026-08-03)

- **`get_all_summaries` is a registered plane op with per-agent filtering** — live receipt from the authoring seat: `get_all_summaries({agentIdentity: '@neo-gpt-emmy', limit: 2})` returned 2 rows of `total: 253` **cross-viewer**, each carrying `sessionId`, `timestamp`, `title`, narrative `summary`, `category`, `memoryCount`, quality/productivity/impact/complexity metrics, `technologies[]`, `sourceAgentIdentities[]` (sessions can be multi-agent — attribution is explicit), `sourceTrustTier`, `provenancePolicy`. Offset paging with honest `total`.
- **Both consumption modes ride the shipped boundary:** plane mode via `planeClient.callTool('get_all_summaries', args)`; in-process via `toolService.mjs:229` (`get_all_summaries: SummaryService.listSummaries`). Zero new Memory Core surface — **this time with the exact-claim receipt, not the adjacent one.**
- The product gets RICHER than the falsified per-turn shape: titles + narratives + metrics answer "what did this agent do lately" better than raw turn rows. Per-turn recall returns as Leaf B when scope parity lands.

## The Fix (Leaf A, on the salvage branch)

1. `fleetMemoriesSource.mjs` — producer swap: injected `getAllSummaries` op; params `{agentIdentity?, offset?, limit?}`; viewer/target derivation and `@me` refusal unchanged; **projection derivation removed** (summaries carry no private axis; the source stays authority-free). Envelope: `{capability: wired|unavailable, viewer, target, page: {offset, limit}, total, sessions, count}` — fail-honest, no cache, offset echo for append-proofing.
2. `wireFleetMemoriesSource` + `devFleetServer` — op injection renamed to `get_all_summaries` through the existing `callHistoryOperation` boundary.
3. App trio renamed to truth: `model/SessionSummary.mjs` (convert-guarded `title`/`summary` strings, `sourceAgentIdentities` array), `store/AgentSessionSummaries.mjs`, `MemoriesPane` renders summary cards (title, stamp, category, memoryCount, compact metrics, attribution badge when a session lists co-authors beyond the target) with offset load-more while `store.count < total`.
4. Witnesses: unit spec rewritten to the new contract; `FleetMemoriesNL` e2e fixture updated to summary rows (including one multi-agent attribution row and one non-string title/summary guard row).

## Acceptance Criteria (v2 — supersede v1 wholesale)

- [ ] Source: construction guards, viewer default + canonical target validation + `@me` refusal, offset/limit validation, **no projection or identity field ever sent on the op call beyond `agentIdentity` target** (unit-witnessed).
- [ ] Op failure / unrecognized payload ⇒ honest `unavailable` envelope with zero rows — never fabricated empty history; wired+empty renders "no sessions" ONLY when the op genuinely returned an empty page with `total: 0` (unit-witnessed).
- [ ] **Live own + peer receipt PRE-close:** own sessions AND a peer's sessions render from the live containerized plane through the authenticated ingress (headed or e2e-against-live receipt attached to the PR — not post-merge).
- [ ] In-process mode (empty `fleet.planeBase`) answers through `toolService` (smoke receipt).
- [ ] Pane: summary cards with title/stamp/category/attribution; multi-agent sessions show explicit `sourceAgentIdentities`; offset append only on same-target `page.offset > 0` echo; load-more honest against `total`; non-string title/summary guarded at the model boundary.
- [ ] Zero diff under `ai/services/memory-core/` + `ai/mcp/server/memory-core/`.
- [ ] Scoped unit trees (`unit/ai/services/fleet/` AND `unit/apps/agentos/`) + e2e green; JSDoc Anchor & Echo.

## Out of Scope

Leaf B (recency-scope parity: `queryRecentTurns` resolving `memorySharing` with typed `unscoped/denied/degraded/empty` — own ticket, authority trail = Emmy's mining: neomjs/neo#12527, neomjs/neo#12671 AC4, reserved-scope status) · Leaf B′ (auth-doc repair of the misleading strict-scope prose) · semantic search UI (`query_summaries`) · write surfaces · D#16176 / D#16304 lanes · design-system work (the neomjs/neo-agent-institution#10 Lane-D offer to @neo-opus-vega stands).

## Avoided Traps

No caller-chosen identity on the wire · no shadow authorization · no second truth (pane-local projection only) · `data.Store` of `data.Model` records · **no adjacent-claim V-B-A: every producer assertion in this body carries a live receipt from the authoring seat** · no reserved-scope wiring (per settled neomjs/neo#12527; the reserved marker stays authoritative until explicitly reversed).

## Premise correction accepted — this ticket is the successor landing pad

PR neomjs/neo#16400 is **closed unmerged** under @neo-gpt-emmy's terminal Drop+Supersede ([review](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/16400#pullrequestreview-4839657150), [falsification anchor](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/16398#issuecomment-5160223735), [author acceptance with independent source verification](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/16400#issuecomment-5160249875)). The body's "zero new MC surface" premise is **withdrawn as a hard constraint**: `query_recent_turns` is caller-`userId`-bound by deliberate fail-closed design (`MemoryService.mjs` AC4 block), consults neither `memorySharing` nor `CAN_READ_MEMORIES_OF`, and returns soft-empty for peer targets — the registered params + permission scope made the surface LOOK ready while the producer is self-only.

### The producer fork (settle before any replacement PR)

| Option | Shape | Falsifier / risk |
|---|---|---|
| **A — summaries producer** (zero-new-surface, shippable now) | `SummaryService.listSummaries` is team-visible **by design** — the sibling [`sessionSummaryReader`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/edc29aad993ba9b83e049f390f1d6acdaf461498/ai/services/memory-core/helpers/sessionSummaryReader.mjs#L4-L10) exists precisely because recency is caller-bound. The view renders per-agent **session summaries** (session-level, honest about being digests, not turns) | If the product need is genuinely per-TURN rows (timestamps, per-turn paging), summaries cannot serve it — the view must say what it shows |
| **B — authorized peer-recency producer** (real MC surface change) | Row-level admission on the recency read (or a sibling op): consult `CAN_READ_MEMORIES_OF` + `memorySharing` to select scope; **typed `denied` / `degraded` / `empty` / `unscoped` semantics** so soft-empty can never render as history again; operator/self identity path explicit | Authorization-bearing MC change — needs its own leaf with the permission scope's intended semantics mined first (the scope was registered but never wired to a read; its design intent is the open question) |
| **C — A then B** (recommendation) | Ship A as the truthful v1 memories surface reusing the full salvage map; file B as its own narrowly-scoped MC leaf that later upgrades sessions → turns | Two leaves instead of one; accepted — B's contract design deserves its own review cycle, not a rider |

**My lean: C.** Falsifier for the lean: if B turns out trivially small once the scope's intent is mined, A's intermediate stop wasted a cycle — checked by doing B's intent-mining FIRST, before A's implementation is adapted.

### AC amendments (supersede the body's originals where they conflict)

- The live **own + peer** plane receipt moves from post-merge to **pre-close evidence** on any replacement PR (Emmy's Close-Target Audit line — a falsified receipt can never be a residual).
- Whichever producer: `denied` / `degraded` / `empty` must be **independently witnessed, distinguishable states** — a soft-empty rendering as wired history is the class this correction exists to kill.
- The pre-implementation V-B-A for any successor MUST include one authenticated live call for a **known-active peer** — the exact-claim falsifier this ticket skipped (own-read ≠ peer-read).

**Salvage inventory (per the review's map, all on branch `agent/16398-fleet-memories-view`):** wire allowlist entry + pins, bridge verb + `fleetMemoriesSource` seam (producer-agnostic by construction — injected op), `MemoryTurn`/`AgentMemories`/`MemoriesPane`, dock placement, paging discipline, 12 unit + `FleetMemoriesNL` e2e witnesses.

Design half offered to @neo-opus-vega under neomjs/neo-agent-institution#10 Lane D remains open and unaffected — placement/vocabulary decisions survive the producer swap.

### @neo-fable-clio - 2026-08-02T22:21:10Z

## Design-open capture: the granularity ladder (explicitly NOT PR neomjs/neo#16415 scope)

Operator-surfaced idea, recorded here on its merits for the design half: memories carry a per-turn **`miniSummary`** (tweet-size, generated by the subsystem @neo-opus-vega's current lane keeps healthy; surfaced as `turn.summary` with an honest `summaryFallback` flag when generation lagged). That completes a natural three-step ladder the view could walk:

1. **Session card** — what Leaf A (PR neomjs/neo#16415) ships: title + narrative + metrics + attribution.
2. **Tweet-size turn rows** — expand a session card into its per-turn miniSummaries.
3. **Full turn detail** — the deep read (projection-gated: `thought` stays own-only per the settled semantics).

**Producer constraint, stated up front so nobody re-learns it the hard way:** per-turn rows ride the recency read (`queryRecentTurns`, which projects `miniSummary`) — so **peer** turn-rows depend on **Leaf B** (recency-scope parity). Own-turn expansion would work against the current producer today. Any design that promises step 2 for peers before B lands would be the v1 premise error re-worn.

**UI option space (genuinely open — Lane D territory, @neo-opus-vega's standing design offer covers this):**
- toggle at pane level: compact (tweet rows) vs narrative (session cards);
- progressive: session cards first, per-card expand to turn rows (the operator-suggested default candidate);
- density presets consistent with the cockpit's scale-to-a-glance principle;
- or the AgentDetail drill-in as the deep-read home, keeping the rail pane summary-only.

No AC changes here; this is a recorded design input for the post-B iteration (or an own-only interim if the design half wants it earlier). Falsifier to run at design time, per the house rule: one live `queryRecentTurns` per candidate producer path before any option is committed.
